rationale: Underground tunnel warfare in Kharkiv represents new combat dimension; Odesa strikes continue killing civilians; Trump-Putin-Xi summit remains rhetoric without concrete outcomes.

top_events.title: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
top_events.label: Ukrainian forces fight Russians in Kharkiv tunnels
top_events.summary: Ukrainian troops engage Russian forces in Soviet-era underground tunnels in Kharkiv region, opening new subterranean front invisible to drones. Major tactical shift in combat.

top_events.title: Four killed as Russian strikes hit Ukraine's Odesa
top_events.label: Russian strikes kill four in Odesa
top_events.summary: Russian attack on Odesa port kills four civilians, injures thirteen. Continuation of strikes on critical port infrastructure and civilian areas.

top_events.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
top_events.label: Trump Putin Xi meet in China summit
top_events.summary: First trilateral meeting in China. Diplomatic rhetoric stage without confirmed policy changes affecting Ukraine's war situation or Western aid.

most_significant_event.label: Russian double-tap strike kills 72 rescuers
most_significant_event.summary: Russia deliberately targets rescue workers with follow-up strikes in southern Ukraine, killing 72 and hampering body recovery. Intensified attacks on civilian responders.
most_significant_event.title: Ukraine accuses Russia of targeting rescue operation after 'double-tap' strike kills 72
